daily.today_energy: Your vibe is giving thoughtful and intentional today. Mercury's got you thinking clearly about what actually matters, so trust those gut feelings when they pop up. This is your moment to realign with what feels true.
daily.love: There's a softness in your connections right now. Whether you're single or coupled up, your energy is magnetic in the most genuine way. Someone's probably noticing the real you—lean into that authenticity without overthinking.
daily.career: Your ideas are worth sharing today, even the unconventional ones. The universe is rewarding initiative and honest communication. Don't dim your light—your perspective brings something valuable to the table that only you can offer.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance between doing and resting. Notice what actually energizes you versus what drains you, then honor that wisdom. Moving your body feels good today, but so does stillness—find your middle ground.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to embrace your natural magnetism, Libra. Venus is whispering about authenticity over perfection, so lean into what feels genuinely you. Trust the timing of things unfolding.
weekly.love: Someone's been noticing your vibe lately. Whether it's deepening an existing connection or attracting fresh energy, this is a moment to be honest about what you actually want instead of what looks good.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. Don't hold back in meetings or creative spaces. The universe is rewarding bold moves and unexpected contributions, so speak up even if it feels unconventional.
weekly.health: Your nervous system is asking for rest disguised as fun. Find activities that feel nourishing rather than draining—think less hustle culture, more intentional downtime. Movement and stillness in balance.
